cost_basis: Requests per article estimated from the pilot cost model (calibrated: modelled 6,124 vs 7,054 successful pilot requests, so x1.15) applied to the mass-tier edit distribution (median 76 edits since 2021, p99 1,732). Retry overhead in the pilot was 6% (HTTP 429).

signals.signal: Revision metadata extensions: edit sizes (added/removed, net, big adds/removes), tags (reverted, reverting, mobile, VisualEditor), hidden revisions, edit-summary classes, page moves (titles at dates)
signals.evidence: Same history pages mass already fetches; only add size|comment|flags|sha1 to rvprop. Reverted share topic 8.6% vs disp 18.2% (Cliff -0.59, n 60/40); empty-summary share 11% vs 16% vs 22% (Cliff -0.45/-0.53); net KB war window topic mean 47.6 vs 8.3 (Cliff +0.30, p 0.02); moves give titles at dates for pageview redirects.
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Hash edit summaries away in memory (keep class flags only); tighten the RM flag on moves (vandal move-revert counted as RM).

signals.signal: Parse the 3 existing snapshots: short description, infobox type + key fields, lead image, categories (explicit), See also, navboxes, concept links (alias-resolved), lead citation classes, disp_P/disp_J split, maintenance and pp templates, headings
signals.evidence: Zero requests (CPU only). SD with framing terms topic 3->5 of 56, comparison 0; infobox 'type' fields carry voice (Nakba, Gaza genocide); concept links Israeli apartheid 1->4->6, settler colonialism 0->2->4 of 54 topic articles; lead refs +33% topic vs -12% disp.
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Resolve link targets through a redirect/alias table (raw watch_links growth is mostly renames); store only concept-link sets and counts, not full link lists; categories miss template-added ones.

signals.signal: Page info, batched 50 titles: current protection, watchers, SD + source, QID, WikiProject assessments, redirect count
signals.evidence: Current EC protection topic 63% / disp 45% / rand 3%; the pilot's log reconstruction missed 12 of 168 current protections, page_info is the ground truth for 'now'. Watchers hidden below 30 (47% of rand).
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Batch 50 titles per call; follow redirect continuation only for pages with >500 redirects.

signals.signal: Account facts of editors (registration, edit count, EC group, current block incl. indef), aggregated per article and window
signals.evidence: Strongest new separator: edits by accounts with <500 edits topic 4% vs disp 11% vs rand 21% (Cliff -0.42/-0.64); median account age 9.5 vs 6.8 vs 6.1 years; EC share 95% vs 88% vs 79%. One call per 50 unique editors (est. ~220k unique editors).
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Use one fixed secret salt for pilot and mass; record block type (partial vs sitewide) from blockinfo; record as-of date; never store names.

signals.signal: Talk page wikitext now: contentious-topic notice, class/importance, press, FAQ, article history, RfC/RM headings
signals.evidence: CT notice topic 67% / disp 48% / rand 3%. Changes over time are small (topic 57->59->67%), so the two older dates add little.
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Drop the 2021 and 2023 talk snapshots (saves 2 requests/article).

signals.signal: Inbound links (linksto:) for the ~35 watch-list concepts and their aliases, not per article
signals.evidence: Inbound counts per sample article add little (topic 3.4k vs disp 6.4k, n.s.). For diffusion, the concepts' own inbound counts at 'now' are enough; history needs dumps.
signals.fixes_before_scaling: 35 requests in total; for history use the pagelinks dumps offline.

signals.signal: Monthly user pageviews, all-access, summed over former titles from the move list
signals.evidence: Needed for exposure weighting (SYNTHESIS P3, data note 3). Views per month war window topic 84.6k vs disp 61.4k vs rand 5.1k.
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Exclude the current partial month (pilot includes 4 days of Nov 2026 in w2); drop the desktop split unless mobile share is needed (+1 request).

signals.signal: Talk revision history: volume, participants, overlap of article editors with talk participants
signals.evidence: Talk edits/month war window topic 28.3 vs disp 5.2 vs rand 0.2; Δ war−w1 Cliff +0.43 vs disp (p 0.03).

signals.signal: RfC and requested-move scan of the talk page + archives touched since 2021 (count, date, closed, RM result)
signals.evidence: Topic RfCs 11 (w1) -> 88 (w2) on 60 articles vs disp 15 -> 6 on 40; 64 of the 88 on Gaza war, Gaza genocide, October 7 attacks, Zionism. RM results parsed for only 7 of 45 topic RMs.
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Store the per-discussion date (not only window totals); improve RM/RfC close parsing (closer's result line, {{archive top|result=}}); flag sections that only mention an RfC.

signals.signal: Wikidata labels/descriptions/aliases in 7 languages: now (batched wbgetentities) + snapshot at 2023-07-01
signals.evidence: English WD description changed 2023->now in 68% of topic vs 38% of disp (Cliff +0.30, p 0.008); Hebrew 40% vs 5%. Mostly rewording; single snapshots can catch vandalism (Zionism 2021).
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Batch the 'now' fetch (50 per call); keep one historical snapshot; drop 2021.

signals.signal: Protection log, reconstructed level at each date
signals.evidence: Topic EC 47% -> 52% -> 63%, disp 10% -> 25% -> 45%, rand 0 -> 0 -> 3%. Within topic, EC-protected pages gained lead terms 45% vs 4% (marker of the core), within disp no difference (30% vs 28%).
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Parse old-format log entries (no 'details': 415 entries), follow move_prot to former titles, anchor 'now' on page_info. Without these fixes the series is a lower bound.

signals.signal: Lead (section 0) term events: every revision in w1 and w2, insert/remove of each critical term and disp_P/disp_J, inserter vs remover account facts, revert fate
signals.evidence: Topic insert rate rose war vs w1 while disp fell (Cliff +0.32, p 0.009, n 60/40). Block-status deep dive depends on it. 50 revisions of content per request; mass edit distribution gives ~5.0 requests/article with a 40-page cap per window.
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Raise the cap for the ~1% heaviest pages (Gaza war stopped on 2023-10-07; Gaza genocide 2024-07; Zionism 2025-02); carry the state across the window boundary; tag restorations (insert by mw-undo/rollback/manual-revert) separately from new insertions; keep per-event account flags (hashed) so indef status can be linked to events without re-deriving it.

signals.signal: LiftWing revert-risk (language-agnostic) on up to 6 lead-event revisions per article
signals.evidence: Worked: 433/433 calls, 0 failures, AUC 0.75 against the mw-reverted tag. No direction asymmetry in topic (insert 0.615, remove 0.631; n 110/103). Mostly a proxy for anonymity (anon 0.95 vs registered 0.62).
signals.fixes_before_scaling: Lower the cap to 6; score by revision; keep only if budget allows.

signals.evidence: 0 of 166 everywhere: English Wikipedia no longer uses central descriptions.
Present on 1 of 60 topic, 2 of 40 disp articles now; nothing to compare. (Free if kept inside snapshot parse.)
Now-only, rate-limited CirrusSearch; topic vs disp n.s. (Cliff -0.17).

signals.signal: AfD pages under the current title
signals.evidence: 0.12 vs 0.15 vs 0 per article; no change dimension.
CT notices and class barely change (Δ CT topic +0.07, disp +0.08).
Zero hits in w1 everywhere, hits on only 6 topic articles in w2, filter names blank (private filters).
